reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 18. Nay or No: 21. Not Voting: 1. Of 39 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 37 (95%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 207 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

donor_industry.caption: From itemized individual contributions over $200 reported to the FEC, grouped by the donor's self-reported employer and occupation. Employer means where the donor works, not that the company gave money; corporations can't give directly to campaigns. Industry groups use simple keyword rules and may misclassify some donors.

stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.

stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

This is what rogue, reckless, and incompetent enforcement looks like, and it cannot go unanswered.

DHS cannot be trusted. We need a full, independent investigation NOW. https://t.co/5ZnwBzX8SK

This is horrifying. It is infuriating. Every single American should be outraged that a father left for work and never came home.

I’m calling for a full, independent investigation into Lorenzo’s death. His family deserves a full https://t.co/9vIev9DDsA

Today, we celebrate 250 years of freedom, democracy, and absolutely NO kings 🇺🇸 https://t.co/OEscslhTEM
Birthright citizenship isn’t a gift from a president, it’s a promise in the Constitution itself. https://t.co/UAOxmmCrRu

Today’s Supreme Court decision makes it clear: Trump is taking legal status away from immigrants who already have it.

Haitian and Syrian TPS holders followed the law, worked, paid taxes and built lives here. Now every TPS holder is wondering: am I next?

Happy “I took away your constitutional rights” anniversary to Donald Trump. 😒

This is unhinged.

Trump is holding a bipartisan housing bill hostage to force through his agenda to suppress votes and rig elections.

While people can’t afford rent, he’s using housing relief as a bargaining chip to cling to power.

His priorities are clear. https://t.co/HMXJWda1X2

Today isn't just about remembering the scourge of slavery, but continuing our commitment to the fight for justice and dignity. 

Wishing everyone a meaningful Juneteenth. https://t.co/xQE8soBCwB

We are closely monitoring the structure fire in Boyle Heights. If you’re nearby, follow all guidance from emergency officials: stay indoors, close windows and doors, and avoid the area if possible.

Check on your neighbors and loved ones, and follow @LAFD for updates. Stay safe. https://t.co/zjoYhGpLDO

What a disgrace. https://t.co/azGuLWa7Oz

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
